business_summary: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a property management service provider in China. The company offers property management services for residential communities under the Oriental Courtesy, Elegant Life, and Harmony Courtyard brands; trinity services, including property management, asset management, and corporate services for commercial and office buildings under the Nebula Ecology brand; and public services under the Poly Public Services brand. It also provides value-added services to non-property owners and property developers, such as pre-delivery services to assist with sales and marketing activities at property sales venues and display units, which include visitor reception, cleaning, security inspection, and maintenance, as well as consultancy, inspection, delivery, and engineering maintenance services; and office leasing services. In addition, the company offers community value-added services to property owners, including home furnishing, parking space agency, house rental and sales agency, housekeeping, parking lot, and other services, as well as community retail and space operations. Further, it provides Energy retrofitting and engineering management services, and catering services, as well as operates real estate agency. The company was formerly known as Poly Property Development Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. in July 2020. Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1996 and is based in Guangzhou, China. Poly Property Services Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Poly Developments and Holdings Group Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Poly Property Services Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 자산 관리 서비스 제공업체로 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 Oriental Courtesy, Elegant Life 및 Harmony Courtyard 브랜드로 주거 지역 사회를 위한 자산 관리 서비스를 제공합니다. Nebula Ecology 브랜드의 상업용 및 사무실 건물을 위한 자산 관리, 자산 관리, 기업 서비스를 포함한 삼위일체 서비스; Poly Public Services 브랜드의 공공 서비스. 또한 비부동산 소유자 및 부동산 개발업자에게 부동산 판매 장소 및 진열장에서의 판매 및 마케팅 활동을 지원하는 인도 전 서비스(방문객 접수, 청소, 보안 검사 및 유지보수는 물론 컨설팅, 검사, 배송 및 엔지니어링 유지보수 서비스 포함)와 같은 부가가치 서비스를 제공합니다. 그리고 사무실 임대 서비스. 또한 이 회사는 홈 퍼니싱, 주차 공간 대행사, 주택 임대 및 판매 대행사, 하우스키핑, 주차장 및 기타 서비스는 물론 커뮤니티 소매 및 공간 운영을 포함하여 부동산 소유자에게 커뮤니티 부가가치 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 에너지 개조 및 엔지니어링을 제공합니다.
